note: alpha=1 for exactly one projection at a time (others alpha=0). teacher-forced token accuracy on one validation utterance; greedy WER on the fixed 20-utt clean subset.
findings: Binarizing a SINGLE attention projection (q, k, v, or o) is already catastrophic (WER ~100-195%); it is not a 'too many layers' effect.
v and o are worst (loss 10.75 / 8.51, token acc 0); q and k somewhat less bad but still ~100-140% WER.

The fp (none) row is WER 3.18 with token acc 0.778: the sub-1.0 token accuracy is a FORMAT artifact (LibriSpeech refs are uppercase; the model emits cased/punctuated text plus a language tag), not misalignment.
Conclusion: the quantizer/scale scheme (per-tensor centered-sign) is the leading suspect for the broken quantized forward, not attention breadth.
